sources.summary: 3rd International Seminar on Territory, Urbanism, and Architecture Research – SIITUA III Ricardo Palma University and U.Llaqta Research Journal present the 3rd International Seminar on Territory, Urbanism, and Architecture Research (SIITUA III), an academic gathering that will bring together researchers, educators, and professionals from Peru, Colombia, Spain, Mexico, Bolivia, Chile, and Luxembourg to share research and reflections on architecture, urbanism, territory, and the environment.
